title: Hang a holder on its keyhole studs
instruction: Hang the orange holder on both keyhole studs of the grey panel.
context: Facilities installers mount tool holders and safety-equipment holders on headed studs. Both heads go through the wide openings, then the holder drops into the narrow slots and hangs on its own. Done by: facilities maintenance workers and equipment installers.
setup: Coordinates are metres: x forward from the arm bases, y left of their midline, z up; the station table top is z=0.7475. All parts start at yaw 0. The fixed grey painted-steel panel has a 0.012 x 0.260 x 0.130 m plate (x,y,z), centre (0.340,0.180,0.8125), near face x=0.334, back x=0.346. Its two steel studs lie along x at y=0.130 and 0.230 (0.100 m apart), z=0.8725: each shank is radius 0.0025 m, length 0.016 m (x=0.318..0.334); each head is radius 0.006 m, thickness 0.003 m (x=0.315..0.318). The loose orange painted-aluminium holder is one 0.120 kg rigid part, origin (0.220,0.200,0.7975). Its plate is 0.004 x 0.160 x 0.090 m, with square 0.024 x 0.024 m entries at local y=+/-0.050, z=0.014 and 0.008 m wide x 0.012 m long slots directly above them (local z=0.026..0.038). The plate consists of a 0.004 x 0.160 x 0.047 m bottom strip centred at local z=-0.0215; three entry-band strips 0.004 m thick and 0.024 m tall, widths 0.018/0.076/0.018 m at local y=-0.071/0/0.071, z=0.014; three slot-band strips 0.004 m thick and 0.012 m tall, widths 0.026/0.092/0.026 m at local y=-0.067/0/0.067, z=0.032; and a 0.004 x 0.160 x 0.007 m top strip centred at local z=0.0415. Its top handle bar is 0.020 x 0.160 x 0.020 m centred at local (0,0,0.055). The fixed dark blue painted-steel rest is a 0.030 x 0.180 x 0.050 m U-channel with origin (0.220,0.200,0.7475): a 0.030 x 0.180 x 0.004 m floor at local z=0.002 and two 0.009 x 0.180 x 0.046 m walls at local x=+/-0.0105, z=0.027, leaving a 0.012 m slot. The holder's bottom begins 0.001 m above the channel floor and the plate is centred with 0.004 m clearance to each wall; it may lean about 9 degrees until the gripper squares it. Panel and rest are anchored fixtures with no simulated mass; only the holder is movable. There are no other task objects or reset marks.
scoring: Highest completed tier, not a sum. Zero unless the holder is upright (tilt at most 5 degrees), its lowest collider point is at least 0.020 m above the table, its whole plate width is within the panel's y span 0.050..0.310 m, no plate corner is beyond x=0.336 and the origin is not behind the panel face x=0.334. Score 0.25 when lifted out of the rest and within 0.050 m of the finite panel face, measured from the plate centre (clamped to the panel rectangle in y,z) and its rear x face. Score 0.5 (inserted; may be held or moving) when the whole plate lies within x=0.316..0.336 m (between the heads' back faces x=0.318 and the panel face x=0.334, with 0.002 m contact tolerance) and both shank centres, measured in the holder frame where each shank axis crosses the plate mid-plane, are inside their keyhole openings: local z 0.0045..0.0375 m, with local y offset from the opening centre line (local y=+/-0.050) at most 0.0095 m while local z < 0.026 (entry) and at most 0.003 m at local z >= 0.026 (slot). This is one continuous band from the entry floors to the slot ends (origin z 0.8350..0.8680 m for an upright, centred holder). The hung pose requires, in addition, that each shank centre bears on its slot's closed end: local z 0.0350..0.0375 m (at most 0.0005 m below the closed end at local z=0.0355, or up to 0.002 m into it as solver penetration; origin z 0.8350..0.8375 m for an upright holder) with local y offset at most 0.003 m; each slot centre has at most 0.003 m yaw-induced x displacement from the holder centre plane (yaw within about 3.44 degrees of 0 or 180). Full credit (1.0) requires the hung pose, release (each gripper's centre point between the pads at least 0.030 m from the holder's bounding box), and rest (speed below 0.010 m/s and spin below 0.500 rad/s), all held continuously for 1.0 second. Success holds 1.0 for 1.0 second more. The bearing rule is per shank and one-sided: any shank more than 0.0005 m below its slot end does not bear; for example, a holder held still 0.8, 1.5 or 2 mm below the seat, or rolled 2 degrees so only one shank bears, earns 0.5. A holder in the hung pose that is held by a gripper, still moving, or released and at rest for less than 1.0 second earns 0.5. Inserted holders 30 mm or 5 mm above lock, 5 mm off centre sideways in the entries, or moving at 0.2 m/s at the seat earn 0.5. A plate in front of the heads, including a handle resting on both heads without insertion, earns 0.25. On the table, leaning more than 5 degrees, one-stud hanging tilted 10 degrees, behind the panel, or off the table earns zero; staging beyond 0.050 m earns zero. Goal origin (0.326, 0.180, 0.837) m; for an upright holder, full credit allows origin x 0.318..0.334 m (the plate anywhere between the head backs and the panel face, 0.002 m contact tolerance); for example, shifts of -0.005 or +0.005 m in x earn 1.0. A 4-degree goal yaw earns 0.5 under the explicit slot-squaring rule, which is stricter than collision fit with the long shanks. A 180-degree yaw is equivalent for this symmetric, two-sided holder.
reset_notes: Keep the panel and rest anchored. Return the holder upright at yaw 0, origin (0.220,0.200,0.7975), its plate in the channel centred with 4 mm clearance per side, 1 mm above the floor; allow it to settle. It may lean about 9 degrees in the channel; the gripper squares it on closing. Use object_jitter=0. Nothing is consumed.
fidelity: Rigid collider unions: 24 mm entries, 12 mm heads, 8 mm slots, 5 mm shanks; 16 mm shanks give the 4 mm plate 6 mm play per side; 12 mm rest slot. Uniform-density mass; no flex, wear or damage; fixtures fixed. Friction 1.2 static/1.0 dynamic; 1 mm contact offsets. Release uses robot joint state (gripper centre points by forward kinematics).
